Jordan (Orthros): Hey team — Orthros here. We have a new request: customer wants a domain-tuned summarizer for underwriting docs (lots of PII/PHI). Need private deploy + HSM + deterministic output for audits. Can you advise onboarding steps?
Maya (CS): Thanks Jordan — huge ask but doable. Quick Q: do they need real-time low-latency (<200ms per request) or batch summarization?
Jordan (Orthros): Primarily near-real-time (200-400ms okay) for their UI, but they also want a nightly batch job. Renewal is up in 4 months; latency risk flagged by customer success as potential churn driver.
Devin (SE): For private deployment with HSM and auditability we should plan Redwood Private with dedicated capacity. We'll need model artifact, tokenization spec, and a safety test suite (prompt set + failure cases).
Maya (CS): Action items: (1) collect sample docs and redaction rules, (2) agree SLOs for latency and throughput, (3) safety eval plan + acceptance criteria, (4) decide model size / quantization. Jordan can you own samples?
Jordan (Orthros): I can get samples — will scrub and share by EOD Thu. Redaction rules: keep policy to preserve dates & claim ids but mask SSNs.
Devin (SE): Draft model config suggestion: ```model: open-13b-adapted
quantization: q4_0
batching: adaptive
cache: prefix-kv
routes: private-only```
Devin (SE): Note: q4_0 helps cost but may affect determinism. If audit determinism is strict we should consider q8 or full fp16 for the critical path.
Sam (Support): FYI ops: we should run a smoke canary in prod mirror then a 2-day A/B compare for hallucination/recall. I'll block support for the canary window.
Maya (CS): Safety evals — propose: 1) 500 prompt set including edge PHI redaction cases, 2) automated rerank/QA checks, 3) human review on 50 random samples. Acceptance: <1% PHI leakage, F1 > 0.82 on entity extraction task.
Jordan (Orthros): Sounds good. Also they require HSM key rotation every 90 days and audit log exports to their SIEM.
Devin (SE): We support KMS/HSM integration. We'll need customer IAM and certs. I'll open an infra ticket for the private plane setup and HSM onboarding doc.
Maya (CS): I'll draft the onboarding playbook and a risk mitigation note for renewal. Include a fallback SLA: if latency > target, we can route to a smaller quantized variant for latency-critical traffic.
Jordan (Orthros): Can you add cost estimates for the two variants (q4 vs fp16) in the playbook? They'll need numbers for procurement.
Devin (SE): Will do. Ballpark: q4 variant ~45% of fp16 token cost but expect ~10-15% slower eval throughput for same GPU due to kernel choices. I'll add detailed perf bench in the ticket.
OpsBot: New infra ticket created: INF-2026-2412 (private-plane + HSM onboarding) — assigned to Devin.
Maya (CS): Great. Next steps: Jordan shares samples by Thu, Devin opens perf/infra PRs, Sam schedules canary window, Maya drafts playbook & renewal risk note. I'll follow up in 48h with a scoping doc. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Orthros): Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll ping once samples are uploaded.
Maya (CS): Also capturing customer feedback ask: they want a one-page enablement deck for product teams post-onboard. I'll include that in the playbook.
Sam (Support): Noted — will prep runbook for on-call for the first 30 days after go-live.
Devin (SE): If Jordan's team can provide a short evaluation harness (scripted queries + expected outputs) that will speed safety regressions. Example harness snippet: ```python
queries = load_csv('orthros_prompts.csv')
for q in queries:
    resp = client.generate(q)
    assert len(resp) > 0
```
Maya (CS): Perfect. Marking thread as blocked until samples come in. Moving to #renewal-watch as FYI for account health. :eyes:
